descriptions.value: A segmentation violation in the gf_props_equal_internal function (/filter_core/filter_props.c) of GPAC Project/MP4Box before 2.5 allows attackers to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) via supplying a crafted data file.

Vulnerability in the Oracle Enterprise Manager for Siebel product of Oracle Enterprise Manager (component: Configuration Management).  Supported versions that are affected are 13.5 and  24.1. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Enterprise Manager for Siebel.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Enterprise Manager for Siebel. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 8.8 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).

descriptions.description: Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Enterprise Manager for Siebel.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Enterprise Manager for Siebel.

descriptions.value: Memory corruption in Loader in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.47 allowed a remote attacker to potentially read memory inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Low)
Improper access control in Ozone in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.47 allowed a remote attacker to leak sensitive information via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

Vulnerability in the Oracle Solaris product of Oracle Systems (component: Image Packaging System).  Supported versions that are affected are 11.3 and  11.4. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Solaris.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Solaris. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 9.8 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).

descriptions.description: Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Solaris.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Solaris.

descriptions.value: Vulnerability in the JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Tools product of Oracle JD Edwards (component: Portal SEC).  Supported versions that are affected are 9.2.0.0-9.2.26.5. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Tools.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Tools accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 5.9 (Confidentiality impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N).
